operatingProtocols.title: Data Flow and Logic
operatingProtocols.description: No authored registry data lives in runtime component or slice files. RTK Query owns the API document cache, feature compositions select the required fields, pure selectors derive view models, and views render those models. https://redux.js.org/tutorials/essentials/part-7-rtk-query-basics

operatingProtocols.title: Theming
operatingProtocols.description: The typed compiled theme profile catalog owns built-in identity, source provenance, tokens, visualization, and motion presentation. Redux owns the visitor's selected mode, while the responsive rail and dock expose theme cycling plus validated custom-theme import and export controls.

operatingProtocols.title: Routing
operatingProtocols.description: Expo Router owns route state and browser history. System compositions derive route-aware view models, and navigation controls issue one explicit route transition per user event.

operatingProtocols.title: Data
operatingProtocols.description: The data flow is API-owned JSON > RTK Query cache > selectFromResult feature composition > pure selector > view. Registry runtime code contains no mirrored server-data slice and no bundled content fallback; API contract types live beside the API boundary.

dossier.headline: I build systems that think locally.
dossier.statement: Twelve years of shipping, most of it spent on the awkward seams: game engines that need to reason without a network, one codebase that has to be native on three platforms, and functional cores that keep their shape whether they are written in TypeScript, C++ or Haskell.

domains.title: Local-first neuro-symbolic AI
domains.summary: NPC engines that reason on the player's machine — no round trip, no rented inference.
domains.detail: ForbocAI builds dialogue, memory-aware interaction and validated action for game worlds, shipped as an Unreal Engine SDK with a visual authoring studio and a hosted API behind it.

domains.title: Functional cores, four languages deep
domains.summary: The same algebra — Maybe, Either, folds, dispatch tables — ported rather than reinvented.
domains.detail: A cyber-noir MUD written entirely in Vimscript on a pure functional architecture, API templates in Haskell, and an Unreal SDK whose data boundaries are composed rather than branched.

domains.title: Universal applications
domains.summary: One Expo codebase that is genuinely native on iOS and Android, and static on the web.
domains.detail: Redux Toolkit for state, RTK Query for the server cache, Tamagui for a design system that compiles to both. This registry is the reference implementation — read its source, then scan the QR.

domains.title: Automation that removes a job, not a step
domains.summary: Pipelines that take a brief in and hand finished work back.
domains.detail: Campaign briefs resolved into multi-format creative through generative imaging, disposable telephony with numbers released the moment a message lands, and agent skills for legal workflows.

principles.title: Composition over branching
principles.description: Route by shape or by key. A dispatch table beats a ternary chain, and a fold beats a loop.

principles.title: Reducers stay pure
principles.description: Effects live at the edges — RTK Query for server cache, listeners for reactive work.

principles.title: Explicit boundaries by default
principles.description: The API is the only content authority. A dead network produces an honest degraded state instead of silently substituting stale bundled copy.

principles.title: Evidence over assertion
principles.description: Every registry claim links to the repository that backs it.
